# Minimum backtest length heuristic (conceptual):
# as the number of strategy configurations N tested grows,
# the backtest history required to trust a high in-sample
# Sharpe ratio grows too -- because (Lesson 17) the expected
# max Sharpe ratio across N trials keeps climbing with N.
#
# 5 configs over a few years of data: plausible.
# 5,000 configs over the same few years: not nearly enough.
caption: If your trial count went up but your backtest history didn't, your bar for "impressive" needs to go up too.
